description: Header file defining the VDSOSupport class for kernel VDSO symbol lookup and related utilities within the absl debugging internal namespace.

classes.name: VDSOSupport
classes.description: Class providing support for detecting and querying the kernel VDSO, including symbol lookup and CPU identification.

methods.name: IsPresent
methods.description: Checks if the VDSO is present in the current environment.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the VDSO symbols.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the VDSO symbols.

methods.name: LookupSymbol
methods.description: Looks up a versioned dynamic symbol in the VDSO by name, version, and type.

methods.name: LookupSymbolByAddress
methods.description: Finds symbol information overlapping a given address.

methods.name: SetBase
methods.description: Replaces the real VDSO base with a mock for testing purposes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes and returns the VDSO base address.
